verdict.rationale: BILL exposes a v3 API and webhooks for S&E transactions and an MCP server, but the MCP server is explicitly scoped to API documentation lookup (for coding assistants), not transaction data access or coding workflows, and there's no evidence of an 'uncoded transactions' endpoint, AI categorization/policy-flag proposal via API, or a review-and-push-back coding loop. missing for 10: MCP server that exposes actual transaction/expense data (not just docs), an API endpoint for pulling uncoded transactions, agent-driven categorization/policy-flag proposal, and a documented push-back-for-review coding workflow.
